title: chatPush builder never sets spaceName: PushItem has no Space
description: build_chat_message_push (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/push.rs, JMAP-nbk3.6) cannot fill ChatMessageEntry.spaceName: PushItem carries Message, Chat, ChatContact and Option<SpaceMember> but no Space, and Chat has no space name. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00 (cefc217) push:121: 'The server MUST support at minimum the following properties: ... spaceName ...'; push:167: 'For "channel" chats, the display name of the containing Space.' validate_chat_push accepts spaceName in properties, so a subscriber asking for it silently gets nothing. Fix: add the containing Space name (e.g. Option<&Space> or Option<&str>) to PushItem; breaking for PushItem struct literals.
close_reason: Fixed in 9ea09267 (JMAP-nbk3.6 review fix): PushItem.space; push.rs:311,324; tests requested_space_name_for_channel, space_name_absent_for_group_even_when_requested
